name: SDF21 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward distant galaxies in the Subaru Deep Field, seen by Hubble.
label: sdf21-hubble
story: Hubble stared into this patch of the Subaru Deep Field to study some of the most distant galaxies confirmed there by spectroscopy. Their faint starlight helps reveal the physical nature of these remote galaxies.

claims.text: SDF21 is a pointing of Hubble program 12616 in the Subaru Deep Field
The program targeted spectroscopically confirmed distant galaxies in the Subaru Deep Field to characterize their physical properties
The resulting study covered spectroscopically confirmed galaxies at z >= 6 with WFC3 near-IR imaging
